svg.title: Juan Carlos Angulo, technical SEO engineer and software engineering student
svg.desc: A light banner with the name Juan Carlos Angulo in large type, the headline Technical SEO engineer and software engineering student, and the line I build the tools I use to audit, publish and measure organic search at scale. A short blue accent bar sits above the name and three small rounded bars sit on the right edge.
